sections.vendors: No new supplier announcements this week. Merchandising director Anna Milne is due to speak at the Drapers Inner Circle Summit on 15 October, worth watching for signals on supplier terms after a weak first half.
sections.strategy: On 29 September John Lewis expanded specialist concessions under its £800m brand transformation programme. Audley Travel hubs arrive in 12 stores from November, Clarendon Fine Art galleries open in three branches, and Randox Health and Tish Lyon are more than doubling their store presence. More floor space is going to services and experiences rather than general merchandise.
sections.launches: The 44-piece RIXO collaboration, John Lewis's biggest fashion collaboration so far, lands on 22 October with prices from £65. It continues the push into partner brands and collaborations alongside Topshop/Topman (32 stores), Rejina Pyo and LABRUM, with Jacqui Markham leading own-brand creative direction.
sections.gossip: The John Lewis website was reportedly down for some customers early on 2 October. JLP's planned Reading build-to-rent scheme is in local news as the Partnership pulls back from housing. The backdrop is the September half-year results: Partnership loss before tax and exceptional items widened to £89m, John Lewis department store sales fell 2% to £2.0bn, and management struck a cautious tone for H2.
soWhat: With department store sales down 2% and a cautious H2 outlook, expect tighter open-to-buy and harder cost negotiations on own-brand textiles. Arrive with value-engineering options rather than flat quotes.

Floor space is moving toward concessions, partner brands and collaborations (RIXO, Topshop, Rejina Pyo), which squeezes some own-brand volume. Suppliers that can serve both JLP own-label and its partner brands are better hedged.

Sustainability compliance stays the price of entry: JLP's 2025/26 report prioritises readiness for the EU Forced Labour Regulation and certified raw materials such as Physical BCI Egyptian cotton. Traceability data should be ready before the SS27 buying rounds.
